name: Satyaranjan Praharaj/ ସତ୍ୟ ରଞ୍ଜନ ପ୍ରହରାଜ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Satyaranjan Praharaj writes mainly poetry in Odia, alongside short fiction. In an author note published by Odisha Sahitya, he recalls beginning to write during his college years and identifies Michha Jahnarati, published in 2021, as his first poetry collection.

The poems gathered here explore the difficulty of giving an account of an inner life. ‘ସାକ୍ଷାତକାର’ stages an interview in which a child's smile resists the accounting of achievement and loss, while ‘ନ ଥିବାର ଦିନ’ fills absence with searching, imagined presences and silence. ‘ନିଘୋଡ’ moves through sleep and cosmic transformation toward an appeal to wake and love again. In ‘ଆଡପାଗଳା’, wounds, roots and soil give estrangement a physical shape.
